items: Outline of marketing strategy and baseline data from lineup announces from previous years (initial sales, traffic, demographics, social engagement, etc)
Lineup announcement date + time set.  Public on sale announcement date + time set.  Major announcements, on sales, and marketing milestones sketched out for the season
Expenses proposed, approved by accounting, and communicated with sub-departments. (I aim to have the full marketing budget done by this point, but at the very least have 3-4 weeks planned).
Set Ticket tiers, prices, amenities and packages. Work with ticketing depot on event built and on sale scheduled.  Early bird tickets taken off-sale.
All announcement dates/times communicated company-wide. Executive report templates built for reporting on announcement.
Logo, date/location, lineup, “Tickets on sale on DATE”, website URL, various branding elements
Hire video team, concept & storyboard, produce, edit and format video, get approvals across artists and key partners
Ticketing page branding assets, packages, pricing, “sold out” graphics, etc
Lineup page, artist pages, sponsor page
Blog post created, upload press release, FAQs updated
Target keywords created and incorporated into copy, make sure all artists + publications are linking back to your website, schema set for a clean search page
Check website for broken images, bad links, and general usability. Perform same test on mobile as well
Written & sent under embargo to key partners. Sent to everyone the day of announce.
Hire publicist, create talking points developed and sent to executives / key personnel that might be interviewed
Contacted, promos and announcements scheduled, graphics distributed the morning of announce
Management all contacted, distributed graphics, suggested announce copy & trackable links
Local contacts (government, tourism board, etc) contacted, distributed collateral with trackable links
Wikipedia and other reference sites updated on announce date
Teasers leading to announcement, Lineup post copy, video uploaded, admat formatted, cover photo, on sale graphics, event updated with lineup info
Teasers leading to announcement, Lineup Post copy, video formatted, admat formatted, on sale graphics
Twitter -Teasers leading to announcement, Post copy, video, admat formatted, on sale graphics
Snapchat -Teasers leading to announcement, Admat formatted, video formatted

Answers for anticipated questions written out ahead of time and communicated to marketing dep’t. Process developed for fielding new questions and getting answers across departments (particularly site ops + production).
Audiences built, Campaigns created, targeting set, graphics created + approved, ad copy by artists
Campaigns created, targeting set, ad copy
Audiences built, Campaigns created, targeting set, graphics created and approved by artists
Audiences built, Campaigns created, targeting set and scheduled
Google Analytics, Facebook analytics, Adroll, etc
All conversion and shopping cart pixels code sent to ticketing company, implemented and tested, cross domain and e-commerce tracking enabled
dashboards created, baseline KPIs from previous announcements recorded for quick reference
Google Analytics naming convention for links created, trackable links (for artists, city, sponsors, publications, digital street team, etc) created and distributed
E-mail list updated with previous year’s buyers, scrubbed, cleaned and segmented
Created, approved by talent, “Add to calendar” link created
Notified and asked to get street team members prepared
Ordered, printed and shipped to team leads on announce date (earlier if no chance of leak)
Local business promos coordinated, set up and tickets sent
Aim to start distributing the day of the announce if possible
Graphics, talking points and trackable links sent, push coordinated with team leads
Negotiated and contracted from top partners, tickets sent to stations
Written, produced, approved by artists and partners, sent to stations
Sent under embargo the day of the announcement
Promotional support secured from top partners, tickets sent out
Approved by artist camp, sent to publication
sponsors all contacted, distributed graphics, suggested announce copy & trackable links
Press release, email, social, video, print ads, radio spots
